title: Durable Workflow: Long-Running Workflows for Laravel
content:
Durable Workflow runs long-running Laravel workflows on your own database, queues, and cache. Learn how it records progress and coordinates background work.

The post Durable Workflow: Long-Running Workflows for Laravel appeared first on Laravel News.
